name: Profile card
summary: One person at a glance: a cover photo and their portrait, who they are, where and what time it is for them, three numbers about their work, and buttons to message or follow them.
use: for a person's profile in a team directory or hover card
a11y: An article labelled with the person's name; the portrait has the person's name as alt text and the cover is decorative; the stats are a description list, and Follow is a toggle button that reports its state with aria-pressed.

use_when: a card that opens when someone clicks a name, to show who they are and their local time before messaging
avoid_when: a list of many people with roles: use member-list
the top of a person's own full profile page: use profile-hero
suggesting people to follow: use follow-suggestions

parts.name: cover
parts.what: a decorative cover photo across the top

parts.name: avatar
parts.what: the person's portrait, overlapping the cover

parts.name: presence
parts.what: their availability, as a small pill

parts.name: name
parts.what: the person's name, the one heading

parts.name: meta
parts.what: one fact with an icon: place, or their local time

parts.name: stats
parts.what: one number about their work with its label; three in a row

parts.name: about
parts.what: a short note about what they do

parts.name: follow
parts.what: a toggle between Follow and Following

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if the profile fails to load, keep the cover and put an alert-banners line in the body with a retry

disabled.how: when the viewer cannot message this person, set disabled on Message and say why in the about line

overflow.how: place and local time wrap onto their own lines when there is no room side by side

long_text.how: name, role and about wrap; the presence pill never breaks

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Enter or Space presses the focused button; Follow switches to Following and back
Message is a button, but the file wires no action to it
